entry_points.text: Requeue moves waiters src to dst with optional prefix wake, resolving keys, optional value check under buckets, plain or PI proxy, returning error or count. PI wait validates addrs/bitset, arms timer, queues, then ignore to early cleanup, locked to fixup plus ref drop, done to proxy wait then cleanup with timeout/interrupt to retry, impossible fatals. Errors EINVAL, ENOSYS, EFAULT, EAGAIN/EBUSY/ETIMEDOUT and restart.

Set enforces exact header size and stores pointer in caller state. Get resolves target with ESRCH and EPERM propagation, reports size and native or compat pointer, fails with EFAULT on copy errors. Compat enforces size and converts pointer.

Dispatcher validates clock/robust combos, branches to wait/wake/requeue/compare/wake-op/PI lock/unlock/requeue-PI, normalizes legacy, forces realtime for classic PI, rejects unknown. Legacy preprocesses timeout only for accepting commands with injection and relative/absolute conversion. 32-bit loads old timeout when accepted. Timeouts only for classic wait, PI lock, bitset and PI requeue wait; classic relative, others absolute. Flags restrict clock/robust and shared/private retry.

Waitv rejects nonzero flags and bad counts, arms absolute realtime/monotonic timer only, allocates array, blocks in multi core, frees and tears down. Wake validates mask strictly then wakes. Wait normalizes flags, validates, arms timer and delegates. Requeue parses two descriptors, mandates identical flags, takes compare from first and delegates.
Read takes id from inode private, rejects out-of-range, sums across possible CPUs, returns decimal line. Write zeroes all CPUs only for reset id, else leaves state while reporting consumption.
Controls exposed as integer sysctls under kernel table registered once. Task init clears held depth/recursion and installs chain key.
Reports improper interrupt restore while already enabled, bracketed to allow instrumentation inside warning path.

exports.text: PI acquire, release and repair with shared/private scope and blocking/timeout/try/retry. Owner-only release via handoff or uncontended path with robust clearing. Covers acquired/stolen/contended, preserves died while installing owner plus waiters, maps errors distinctly, waits exiting owner, retries after faults.

RT proxy for futex PI: nonblocking try, start with chain walk, interruptible wait, cleanup resolving steals. Wrapper holds wait lock irq-saved, removes waiter on failure, keeps preempt disabled across unlock and wakeup flush.
Completes wakeup for waiter requeued onto PI state: unqueues, detaches RT linkage, refreshes key and lock, records locked and wakes task.
Reader semaphore killable acquire that may sleep with interruption report, and release pairing dependency tracking with internal unlock.

hazards.text: Unresolvable user access leaves user immutable while forcing kernel owner to realtime owner; divergence causes later unlock rejection.

Waking PI waiter via non-PI path warns and refuses; must use PI path. Else unlinks from bucket and publishes null lock with release ordering after removal, else spinner could free waiter still queued.

invariants.text: Requeue adopts new key, transfers accounting/lock only across differing buckets. PI needs RT waiter without PI state bound for dest, plain needs neither, bound PI rejected. Proxy validates top, prepares, delegates to PI atomic, wakes on immediate else rewinds, forces waiters bit if more; outcomes locked/idle/progress/done/ignore/wait. Needs distinct src/dst by address then key, one wake, non-negative counts and cache. Mismatch yields contention. Faults drop locks, fault outside, full retry shared or bucket-only private. Exiting owner waits/yields/retries. Deadlock stops queuing, drops ref, clears waiter.

Wait locks bucket before user page, validates value under lock, rejects same-key pairs, sets TASK_INTERRUPTIBLE plus TASK_FREEZABLE for current, then enqueues. Sleep arms HRTIMER_MODE_ABS timer, skips schedule if unlinked or expired, restores TASK_RUNNING.

Robust query defaults to caller, resolves pid under RCU with ESRCH on miss, pins task, holds exec-update read lock killably across PTRACE_MODE_READ_REALCREDS check and fetch, returns native or compat head, releases before dropping ref.

Reader-owned with no writer count and owner flag. Debug unlock asserts magic/ownership, clears flag, subtracts bias release-ordered, warns if negative, disables preempt, clears non-spinnable and wakes when only waiters remain. Grants bounded by bias, clear waiter/handoff on empty/grant, refuse readers under writer, request handoff after timeout. Writer-headed wakes head only; reader-headed early grants with steal check then collects before clearing.

Proving and stats are writable integers defaulting on. Classes and keys counted with high-water and zap. Held id packs class plus read flag, chain index derives from held class. Keys canonicalize per-CPU base, accept static else shut down; transient registration disables validator.

Traces append to static store, shut down with sizing diagnostic on exhaustion else capture, hash and reuse identical. Event table sized count plus one with reset aliased to count. Counting adds on current CPU. Counter files root read-only, dot-prefixed reset root write-only.

locks.text: Bucket precedes PI wait lock. Handoff holds one across transition to observe arrivals. Fault/reschedule drops both then reacquires bucket then wait with revalidation. Repair needs queue lock, takes wait lock irq-disabled, drops for faults. Steal, resize and user writes need revalidation and discard of departing waiters without missing arrivals.
Proxy start needs wait lock held, tries immediate take before chain walk. Cleanup manages interrupt disable and waiter repair around removal.

Requeue holds both buckets via paired double lock with ref keeping second alive, bumps waiter count across section, migrates under both. Early needs source bucket held with waiter lock equal, needs only source. Early unlinks if queued, reports timeout on expiry, restartable interrupt on signal, else contention retry.

Wakeup inspects queue under waiter spinlock irq-saved, marks head if present, unlocks then drains wake queue outside and returns semaphore. Realtime read unlock fast-paths atomic dec, takes waiter lock irq-disabled only on last reader, holds preempt disabled across unlock and drain.

Wake-op resolves two keys, double-locks in order, runs user atomic under locks, scans chains, unlocks before waking. Rejects PI/RT state; faults fault-in, reschedule and re-resolve with private fast versus full shared retry, non-fault errors terminal. Multi pins private hash, resolves all keys before task state, locks one bucket at a time, unwinds on fault and retries. Encoding packs op, comparison and two signed 11-bit immediates with clamped shift-to-mask; comparisons cover eq/ne plus four ordered.

Marked wake holds task ref across unqueue, drops on refusal, queues safe wakeup for after bucket unlock. Validator uses spinlock plus owner and per-CPU recursion, irq-disabled with mismatch warning. Graph takes validator lock with count, aborts if checking off, one variant disables checking on release.

state_machines.text: Preparation refuses ignored waiters, completion records success or deadlock with early-wake interaction, sync wakeup observes completion or parks until progress finishes.

Setup holds bucket, sleeps until wake/timeout/signal, unqueue maps dequeued/success, expired/timeout, signal/restart, else retries spurious. Restart rebuilds timeout, disables auto-restart, reissues wait.
Loops setup yielding success/mismatch/fault/woken index, sleep skipped if dequeued or timer fired, unqueue maps expiry/signal to timeout/restart with retry on spurious.

structs.text: Template defines wake callback, empty key, match-any bitset and idle state with linkage at queue time; states NONE 0, IGNORE 1, IN_PROGRESS 2, WAIT 3, DONE 4, LOCKED 5. Multi pairs flags/value/address with queue node via validator rejecting reserved bits. Single interrupt records address, value, time, bitset and timeout presence. Unqueue returns highest dequeued index.

Task holds native and compat robust heads. Timer sleeper carries expiry marker plus timer cancelled/destroyed on exit. Semaphore shows magic, count, owner and wait list. Queue element carries key plus requeue key, list node, task, bitset, optional RT waiter and PI state, lock pointer, hash handle and wake callback. Debug warns once then disables, non-debug empty.
Waiters form circular doubly linked list anchored by first pointer; successor needs waiter lock, returns null on wrap.
Per-CPU unsigned counters indexed by event hold totals. Boot init creates dir plus event and reset files, removes tree and warns on failure.
